pcb/controller.title: Drive controller · R1
pcb/controller.note: Audio R1: U7 LM386 amplifier and J6 speaker output. J4 pin6 is reserved. J3 connects to the removable contact harness; rear J2 is standard floppy power. Static checks pass; audio firmware and powered prototypes remain pending.

pcb/contact.title: Leaf-spring contact board · R1
pcb/contact.note: Green J1 screw terminal is on the UNDERSIDE. Seven 26 AWG wires connect 1:1 to controller J3; trim solder tails to 0.5 mm. Hardware R3: routed boards with solder mask, readable silkscreen and the RODDY logo. Saved-file ERC/DRC and schematic-to-pad checks pass. Isolated media power, hardware interlock, default input bias and board-mounted ports are included. Powered prototypes and real-host qualification remain necessary.

parts.note: Four M3 side screws into original CD-ROM mounting holes; install outside case then slide from rear.
Continuous rounded U lens with captive lower flange, 0.2 mm nominal channel clearance. Side-return brightness needs a physical optical sample.
TH LED saddle. Three LEDs wired in series for data; parallel 5 V/GND. 100 nF directly across each LED supply.
Adafruit 1938, 5 mm diffused RGB pixel; fitted body envelope.

Remove rear tray before sliding out drive. All five rear ports solder to R3 PCB. Six PCB supports distribute plug loads. Port faces recessed 1 mm; IEC recessed 5 mm to keep shell tabs on the PCB. Trim solder tails to <=1.5 mm below board.
SIGNAL: main drive J4 to daughterboard J4. 10-way 1:1 ribbon; dock pins 2/7 unconnected. 220 mm cut length plus termination allowance; routed centerline and plug envelopes require a sample fit.
Pin-1 orientation stripe; confirm mating orientation against both board drawings.
Drive controller J4 dock link, distinct from the 34-pin floppy header. Position follows controller R1 pin map.

Other end of the same 10-way ribbon: daughterboard J4. Purchased mating housing still needs qualification.
Drive J2 floppy power: +5V and GND only; 12V position unused. Mating housing envelope.
Daughterboard J6 supplies drive power separately from J4. Harwin M20-1060200, 14 mm socket housing.
POWER: daughterboard J6 +5V to drive J2 +5V. Disconnect before core removal; not a 12V supply.
POWER RETURN: daughterboard J6 GND to drive J2 GND. TE 171822-4 / 170204-2 and Harwin M20 sockets; 22 AWG stranded wire.

Service-loop envelope; actual harness wire gauge, termination and bend radius require validation.
